questions.question: What covers all admitted limits and existing semantic channels?

Derived tests must cover candidate-dense inputs and all pattern families, not anchor-free timing alone.

questions.question: How do current/older parents handle deadlines, facts and cleanup?

Compact scalar completeness survives older bounds; verified publication/consent facts and owned cleanup remain separate. Unchanged older-parent failure fallback and whole-upgrade timing are explicit residuals.

reviews.strongest_alternative: Stage anchor guard/minimal result adapter, then reporting containment, then traversal/parser/retention. All fixed seats retain one coherent wave; staging belongs only to separately authorized urgent partial release.

improvements_recommended.recommendation: Use an explicit lexical no-follow screen in addition to contained_files; helper accepts an in-root final link. Keep refusal/incomplete status bounded and truthful.

Verify all pattern families, candidate-dense and multi-file cumulative work, three channels/fences/dispositions and required-live host files; the literal-anchor guard alone is insufficient.
Exercise cleanup/report failure with verified-owned versus unowned pack controls and parent/child contradiction cases; preserve recovery, publication and consent authorization.
